schema.description: A `201` status code indicates that your dictionary was created successfully and all terminology content from your uploaded file was processed and integrated into the CAMB.AI system. This represents the ideal outcome where file parsing, content validation, and dictionary population all completed without issues, resulting in a fully functional dictionary ready for immediate use across your audio processing tasks.

A `206` status code indicates a more complex outcome where the dictionary container was created successfully, but some terminology entries from your uploaded file could not be processed or integrated. This partial success scenario reflects the reality that large terminology collections often contain edge cases or formatting variations that require individual attention, even when the majority of content processes correctly.

Limit how many terms are returned when fetching the dictionary details. You can specify exactly how many terms you want to see. For example, setting `limit=50` will return only the first 50 terms from the dictionary. This is especially useful for implementing pagination in user interfaces or when you only need a sample of the dictionary's content.

output_format.description: The audio file format for the generated speech stream.

sample_rate.title: Sample Rate

apply_enhancement.title: Apply Enhancement
apply_enhancement.description: If `true`, applies output audio enhancement (loudness, denoising, polish). Defaults to `true` for most models; `false` for the speed-oriented `mars-flash` and `mars-8.1-flash-beta` models. Set explicitly to override the per-model default.

enhance_reference_audio_quality.title: Enhance Reference Audio Quality
enhance_reference_audio_quality.description: Remove noise from reference audio. (useful when the reference has background noise or compression).

maintain_source_accent.title: Maintain Source Accent
maintain_source_accent.description: Maintain the accent from the original source audio.

speaking_rate.title: Speaking Rate
speaking_rate.description: Controls playback speed for generated speech.

stability.title: Stability
stability.description: Balances voice consistency and audio quality. Lower values keep the voice closer to the original speaker, higher values improve clarity and smoothness—especially useful for weaker reference audio.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness. Higher values increase variation and expressiveness.

inference_steps.title: Inference Steps
inference_steps.description: Higher values may improve fidelity at the cost of latency.

speaker_similarity.title: Speaker Similarity
speaker_similarity.description: Adjusts how closely the generated voice matches the original speaker’s voice.

localize_speaker_weight.title: Accent Boost
localize_speaker_weight.description: Controls how much the voice shifts toward a native accent in the target language, at the cost of changing the speaker’s original voice identity slightly.

acoustic_quality_boost.title: Acoustic Quality Boost
acoustic_quality_boost.description: Reduce acoustic noise at the cost of slightly worse speaker similarity.

enhance_named_entities_pronunciation.description: If `true`, improves pronunciation of names, brands, and other named entities.

target_languages.description: Languages to generate output in. Pass locale tags (`es-es`, `fr-fr`, `de-de`). Numeric language IDs still work but are deprecated. [See all target languages](/api-reference/endpoint/get-target-languages).

voice_description.title: Voice Description
voice_description.description: A detailed description (minimum 18 words/100+ characters) of the desired voice characteristics. Be specific about gender, age, accent, emotional tone, speaking style, or cultural context to guide the synthesis engine in creating an authentic voice.

short_name.title: Short Name

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: An array of strings to be translated. This field is required and can contain multiple text segments for batch translation.

age.title: Age
age.description: An integer representing the intended audience age. This helps adjust vocabulary and expressions to be age-appropriate, which is particularly important when translating content for children, teenagers, or specific age demographics.

formality.title: Formality
formality.description: Specifies whether the translated text should be formal or informal. This affects the tone and word choices in languages.

gender.description: Specifies grammatical gender preferences when relevant in the target language. In many languages, adjectives, nouns, and verbs may change form based on gender, and this parameter helps ensure the translation uses the appropriate forms.

chosen_dictionaries.description: An optional parameter that allows you to specify specialized vocabulary dictionaries to use during translation. This ensures that technical terms are translated appropriately for specific fields like medicine, law, technology, or other industries.

video_url.title: Output Video URL
video_url.description: Direct link to download the complete dubbed video file.

audio_url.title: Output Audio URL
audio_url.description: Direct link to download the isolated dubbed audio track.

transcript.description: Array of dialogue items containing speaker identification, timing information and textual transcript for each dialogue item.

audio_url.description: The URL pointing to the generated audio file for the story.

background_audio_url.description: The URL pointing to the generated audio file for the detected background audio.

previews.description: An array of two distinct URL strings, each pointing to a unique voice sample generated from your text prompt. team_id.title: Team ID
team_id.description: Unique identifier for the team that owns this folder within the CAMB.AI workspace. This establishes the organizational hierarchy and ensures that folder access permissions align with your team's collaboration settings, allowing team members to share and manage projects collectively while maintaining proper access control.

folder_id.title: Folder ID
folder_id.description: Unique system identifier for this specific folder within your CAMB.AI workspace. folder_name.title: Folder Name
folder_name.description: Display name for the folder as it appears in your CAMB.AI workspace dashboard. run_count.title: Run Count
run_count.description: Total number of completed tasks and processing runs currently stored within this folder. This metric provides valuable insight into folder activity levels and helps you monitor project volume, making it easier to assess workspace utilization and identify your most active project categories for better resource planning and organization.

age.title: Age

description.title: Description

transcript.title: Transcript

is_published.title: Is Published

description.title: Dictionary Description

This optional field can contain a longer explanation of what the dictionary covers, its intended audience, or special characteristics that set it apart from other dictionaries. The description might explain the scope of terms included, the expertise level assumed, or specific domains covered.

created_at.title: Creation Date
created_at.description: Dictionary Creation Timestamp. This date-time value tells you exactly when someone first created this dictionary in the system. Understanding creation dates helps you gauge how established a dictionary is and can be useful for administrative purposes, auditing, or simply satisfying curiosity about a dictionary's history. The timestamp includes both date and time information, giving you precise historical context.

updated_at.title: Update Date
updated_at.description: Last Modification Timestamp. Perhaps one of the most practically useful pieces of metadata, this timestamp shows when someone last made changes to the dictionary. This could mean adding new terms, modifying existing definitions, updating the dictionary's name or description, or any other modification. For applications where content freshness matters, this timestamp helps you and your users understand how current the dictionary's information might be.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Optional voice IDs from [`GET /list-voices`](/api-reference/endpoint/list-voices) to use for dubbed speech. When providing voices, include different genders and tones so each speaker can be matched to the most suitable voice.

dictionaries.title: Dictionaries
dictionaries.description: Optional dictionary IDs for custom terminology (up to 5), from [`GET /dictionaries`](/api-reference/endpoint/list-dictionaries).

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Optional scheduled start in ISO 8601 with a UTC offset, e.g. `2026-08-01T19:30:00Z`. If omitted, the stream starts as soon as it is created. Cannot be in the past; at most 7 days in the future.

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: When the stream stops, in ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Required; must be at least 15 minutes after the start. To end a stream earlier, delete it; to change the end, patch it.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone name (e.g. `UTC`, `Europe/London`) that `start_time`/`end_time` are expressed in. Its offset must match the timestamps.

audio_selections.title: Audio Selections

processing_profiles.title: Processing Profiles

encoding_profiles.title: Encoding Profiles

id.description: Your identifier for this profile, referenced by `pipelines[].profile`.

demixing.description: Separate speech from background music/effects before transcription.

translating.description: Translate the transcript into each output language.

revoicing.description: Synthesise dubbed speech in the output language.

mixing.description: Optional mix gains for dubbed output. Requires `revoicing` to be enabled.

scte35_dubbing_control.description: Optional automatic dubbing toggling on SCTE-35 ad-break markers.

id.title: ID
id.description: Your identifier for the produced asset, referenced by `target_streams[].inputs[].asset_id`.

language.description: Language of the asset. Required for `audio` and `subtitle` outputs. Numeric language ID. Use [`GET /source-languages`](/api-reference/endpoint/get-source-languages) for valid `source_language` values and [`GET /target-languages`](/api-reference/endpoint/get-target-languages) for valid output `language` values. For example, `1` is English (US) and `54` is Spanish (Spain).

ProcessingPipeline.title: ProcessingPipeline
ProcessingPipeline.description: Connects one audio selection to a processing profile and declares the assets to produce. A pipeline that produces an `audio` output must also produce a `subtitle` output.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: Assets this pipeline produces. Output `id`s must be unique across all pipelines.

ProducedAssetKind.title: ProducedAssetKind
ProducedAssetKind.description: Type of asset a pipeline output produces.

AudioSelection.title: AudioSelection
AudioSelection.description: Names an audio track of the source so pipelines can reference it by `id`.

id.title: ID
id.description: Your identifier for this selection, referenced by `pipelines[].audio_selection`.

source.title: Source
source.description: Audio track selector. Accepts FFmpeg-style selectors (`a:0`, `1`, `eng`, `#0x1fe`, `i:301`, optionally with a channel suffix like `:ch0,1`) or magic selectors (`$first_audio`, `$second_audio`, `$last_audio`). Use [Probe a Source Stream](/api-reference/endpoint/streaming/probe-stream) to discover tracks.

source_language.description: Language spoken on the selected track. If the audio mixes several languages, use the main one; multilingual input is handled automatically. Numeric language ID from [`GET /source-languages`](/api-reference/endpoint/get-source-languages), e.g. `1` for English (US).

background.title: Background
background.description: Optional selector (same syntax as `source`) for a clean background/music track. When set, it is used as the background bed for mixing instead of demixing the source.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Track metadata from the source, e.g. `{"language": "eng"}`. Useful for picking the right track.

id.title: ID
id.description: MPEG-TS PID of the track (hex string), when the source is MPEG-TS. Usable in selectors like `i:301`.

TargetStream.title: TargetStream
TargetStream.description: A destination for the processed stream. `url` is required except for auto-hosted types (SRT listener and HLS recording), whose URLs are generated and returned.

id.title: ID
id.description: Your identifier for the target, e.g. `youtube-es`.

url.title: URL
url.description: Destination URL to push to. Omit for SRT listener (`6`) and HLS recording (`3`) targets - their URLs are generated and returned in the create response and stream status.

passthrough_policy.description: Which source tracks are forwarded alongside the listed `inputs`. With `all` (the default), source tracks not replaced by a pipeline output are forwarded automatically.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Tracks to include in this output. May be omitted when `passthrough_policy` is `all` or for auto-hosted target types.

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: SRT encryption passphrase to use when pushing to the destination.

streamid.title: Stream ID
streamid.description: SRT `streamid` to send when connecting to the destination.

constant_bitrate.title: Constant Bitrate
constant_bitrate.description: MPEG-TS constant-bitrate control: `false`/omitted for variable bitrate, `true` to derive the mux rate from the source bandwidth, or an explicit rate string such as `"500k"` or `"5M"`.

latency.title: Latency
latency.description: SRT send latency in milliseconds (20-8000). Higher values tolerate more network jitter at the cost of delay. Recommended: `2000` for typical internet links.

TargetStreamInput.title: TargetStreamInput
TargetStreamInput.description: One track of a target output. Set exactly one of `asset_id` (a pipeline output) or `passthrough_selector` (an unprocessed source track).

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: `id` of a pipeline output to include.

passthrough_selector.title: Passthrough Selector
passthrough_selector.description: Selector (e.g. `v:0`, `a:eng`) for a source track to forward unprocessed.

pid_policy.description: How the MPEG-TS PID for this track is chosen.

pid.title: PID
pid.description: Explicit MPEG-TS PID (32-8190). Required when `pid_policy` is `explicit`, forbidden otherwise.

encoding_profile.title: Encoding Profile
encoding_profile.description: `id` of an entry in `encoding_profiles`. Required when `encoding_policy` is `explicit`, forbidden otherwise.

StreamCategory.title: StreamCategory
StreamCategory.description:
Content category of the source stream, used to tune processing.

| Value | Category |
|---|---|
| `1` | News and information |
| `2` | Sports and entertainment |
| `3` | Business and professional |
| `4` | Education and training |
| `5` | Events and ceremonies |
| `6` | Government and official |

EncodingPolicy.title: EncodingPolicy
EncodingPolicy.description: How this input is encoded on the output: `preserve` copies the source codec where possible, `auto` picks sensible defaults, `explicit` applies the referenced `encoding_profile`.

EncodingProfile.title: EncodingProfile
EncodingProfile.description: Reusable encoding settings, referenced by `target_streams[].inputs[].encoding_profile`. Must set at least one of `audio_codec` or `video_codec`.

OverdubConfig.title: OverdubConfig
OverdubConfig.description: Relative gains used when mixing dubbed audio over the original. `original_audio_gain` + `background_audio_gain` must not exceed 1.0.

original_audio_gain.title: Original Audio Gain
original_audio_gain.description: Volume of the original speaker while dubbed audio plays (0.0-1.0).

background_audio_gain.title: Background Audio Gain
background_audio_gain.description: Volume of background music/ambience during dubbed segments (0.0-1.0).

fallback_audio_gain.title: Fallback Audio Gain
fallback_audio_gain.description: Volume of the original audio while nothing is being dubbed (0.0-1.0).

fade_time.title: Fade Time
fade_time.description: Cross-fade duration in seconds when switching between original and dubbed audio (0-5).

StreamType.title: StreamType
StreamType.description:
Protocol/type of a target stream.

| Value | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `1` | SRT caller | Push output to your SRT endpoint (Camb.ai connects out to `url`). |
| `2` | RTMP | Push output to an RTMP ingest `url`. |
| `3` | HLS recording | Camb.ai-hosted HLS output; `url` and `inputs` are auto-assigned, and the playback URL is returned. |
| `4` | YouTube RTMP | Push directly to a YouTube RTMP ingest URL. |
| `5` | YouTube HLS | Push directly to a YouTube HLS ingest URL. |
| `6` | SRT listener | Camb.ai hosts an SRT endpoint that you (or your player) pull from; `url` is auto-assigned and returned. |

PIDPolicy.title: PIDPolicy
PIDPolicy.description: How MPEG-TS packet identifiers (PIDs) are assigned on the output: `preserve` keeps the source PID (passthrough inputs only), `auto` assigns one automatically, `explicit` uses the provided `pid`.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Language IDs available on this output URL.

url.title: URL
url.description: URL of this output for the listed languages. For Camb.ai-hosted outputs (SRT listener, HLS recording) this is a playback URL you can distribute; for push outputs it echoes your destination URL.

stream_id.title: Stream ID
stream_id.description: Identifier of the created stream, used for all lifecycle operations.

stream_url_for_languages.title: Stream URL For Languages
stream_url_for_languages.description: Playback URLs for the outputs, grouped by language.

task_id.title: Task ID
task_id.description: Identifier of the setup task; useful when contacting support.

url.title: Url
url.description: Source stream URL to probe, e.g. `srt://example.com:9000`.

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Optional passphrase for authenticated streams (commonly used with SRT).

stream_id.title: Stream Id
stream_id.description: Optional SRT `streamid` the source requires. This is not the Camb.ai stream ID.

video_streams.title: Video Streams
video_streams.description: Video tracks discovered in the source stream.

audio_streams.title: Audio Streams
audio_streams.description: Audio tracks discovered in the source stream.

data_streams.title: Data Streams
data_streams.description: Data tracks discovered in the source stream (e.g., SCTE-35 ad markers).

UpdateStreamDataRequestPayload.title: UpdateStreamDataRequestPayload
UpdateStreamDataRequestPayload.description: Partial update of a stream. All fields are optional; omit anything you do not want to change. List fields carrying `id`s (`audio_selections`, `processing_profiles`, `encoding_profiles`, `pipelines`, `target_streams`) are merged by `id`: entries you send are added or replaced, existing entries are never removed.

initial_delay.title: Initial Delay
initial_delay.description: New setup lead time in seconds.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Replacement list of voice IDs. Empty means voices are cloned from the source speakers.

dictionaries.title: Dictionaries
dictionaries.description: Replacement list of dictionary IDs (up to 5).

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: New scheduled start (ISO 8601 with UTC offset). Requires `timezone`.

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: New scheduled end (ISO 8601 with UTC offset). Requires `timezone`.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone the updated times are expressed in.

audio_selections.title: Audio Selections
audio_selections.description: Audio selections to add or replace (merged by `id`).

processing_profiles.title: Processing Profiles
processing_profiles.description: Processing profiles to add or replace (merged by `id`).

encoding_profiles.title: Encoding Profiles
encoding_profiles.description: Encoding profiles to add or replace (merged by `id`).

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.description: Pipelines to add or replace (merged by `id`).

target_streams.title: Target Streams
target_streams.description: Target streams to add or replace (merged by `id`).

pipeline_patches.title: Pipeline Patches
pipeline_patches.description: Live, runtime-only adjustments to running pipelines: toggle dubbing, adjust the mix, or nudge A/V sync. Applied immediately and not persisted into the stream configuration.

Languages.title: Language ID
Languages.description: Numeric language ID. Use [`GET /source-languages`](/api-reference/endpoint/get-source-languages) for valid `source_language` values and [`GET /target-languages`](/api-reference/endpoint/get-target-languages) for valid output `language` values. For example, `1` is English (US) and `54` is Spanish (Spain).

StreamStatus.title: StreamStatus
StreamStatus.description:
Lifecycle status of a stream.

| Value | Status | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `1` | Scheduled | Created and waiting for its start time. |
| `2` | Setting up | Resources are being provisioned. |
| `3` | Started | Live and processing. |
| `4` | Ended | Completed normally. |
| `5` | Interrupted | Stopped before its scheduled end. |
| `6` | Error | Failed; see the `error` field. |

ProcessingOption.title: ProcessingOption
ProcessingOption.description: Selects the model tier for a processing step: `none` disables the step, `best_model` prioritises quality, `fast_model` prioritises latency.

PassthroughPolicy.title: PassthroughPolicy
PassthroughPolicy.description: `all` forwards every source track that is not replaced by a pipeline output; `none` forwards nothing unless explicitly selected.

Scte35DubbingControl.title: Scte35DubbingControl
Scte35DubbingControl.description: Automatically toggles dubbing on SCTE-35 ad-break markers. Each field is the dubbing state to apply on that marker (`enabled` or `disabled`); set a field to `null` to ignore that marker. Omit the whole object to ignore SCTE-35 entirely.

on_out_of_network_start.title: On Out-of-Network Start
on_out_of_network_start.description: Dubbing state applied when an ad break starts.

on_out_of_network_end.title: On Out-of-Network End
on_out_of_network_end.description: Dubbing state applied when an ad break ends.

delay.title: Delay
delay.description: Audio/video sync adjustment in seconds (-2.0 to 2.0). Positive values delay audio. Unset by default (no adjustment).

PipelinePatch.title: PipelinePatch
PipelinePatch.description: A live, runtime-only adjustment to one pipeline of a running stream. Not persisted into the stream configuration.

dubbing_enabled.title: Dubbing Enabled
dubbing_enabled.description: Turn live dubbing on or off for this pipeline. `false` pauses dubbing and passes the original audio through; `true` resumes it. Takes effect within a few seconds.

mixing.description: Live adjustment of the dubbing mix gains.

type.description: Best-effort protocol of the source, inferred from its URL. May be `null`.

playback_url.title: Playback URL
playback_url.description: URL where the source can be played back, when available.

id.title: ID
id.description: Target identifier from the create payload.

state.title: State
state.description: Lifecycle state of this target output.

playback_url.title: Playback URL
playback_url.description: URL to play this output, for Camb.ai-hosted outputs.

destination_url.title: Destination URL
destination_url.description: URL this output is being pushed to, for push-type targets.

StreamView.title: StreamView
StreamView.description: Current state of a stream. The shape is identical whether the stream is scheduled, live, or finished.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: State and URLs of each output.

FlowMode.title: FlowMode
FlowMode.description: `caller`: Camb.ai connects out to your SRT endpoint (`primary_url`) and re-serves it. `listener`: Camb.ai hosts an SRT endpoint that your encoder pushes to.

role.title: Role
role.description: Which leg of the flow this URL feeds.

FlowCreateIn.title: FlowCreateIn
FlowCreateIn.description: Configuration for a new stream flow - a standing SRT endpoint you can use as the source or a target of any stream.

label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable name for the flow. Must be unique within your team.

failover.title: Failover
failover.description: Enable a second (backup) leg. Caller flows then require `backup_url`; listener flows get a backup push URL.

primary_url.title: Primary URL
primary_url.description: SRT URL of your upstream (caller mode only; required there, forbidden for listeners). To dial an encrypted upstream, append its passphrase as a query parameter: `srt://host:port?passphrase=...`.

backup_url.title: Backup URL
backup_url.description: SRT URL of the backup upstream. Caller mode with `failover` enabled only.

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: Optional SRT encryption passphrase for the flow's own endpoint (10-79 characters). When set, it is embedded in the returned play/push URLs and required to connect.

FlowUpdateIn.title: FlowUpdateIn
FlowUpdateIn.description: Partial update of a flow. Only `label` and `active` can change; to change URLs, mode or failover, delete and recreate the flow.

active.title: Active
active.description: Set `true` to bring the flow's relay online, `false` to take it offline.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the flow's relay is currently online.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the flow's relay is currently online.

key.title: Key
key.description: Access key embedded in the flow's URLs.

play_url.title: Play URL
play_url.description: SRT URL the flow serves. Use it as `source_stream.url` or as a `target_streams[].url`, or play it directly.

push_urls.title: Push URLs
push_urls.description: SRT URLs to push into (listener mode). Empty for caller flows.

passphrase.title: Passphrase
passphrase.description: The flow's SRT encryption passphrase, when one is set.

frame_rate.title: Frame Rate
frame_rate.description: Frame rate as a fraction, e.g. `25/1`.

id.title: ID
id.description: MPEG-TS PID of the track (hex string), when the source is MPEG-TS. Usable in selectors like `i:301`.

id.title: ID
id.description: MPEG-TS PID of the track (hex string), when the source is MPEG-TS. Usable in selectors like `i:301`.

name.title: Name
name.description: The template's name, unique within the workspace.

stream_id.title: Stream Id
stream_id.description: The stream this template was saved from.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: A stream creation payload compatible with the Create Stream request body. Adjust start_time and end_time before creating a stream from it.

SubtitleFormattingOptions.title: SubtitleFormattingOptions
SubtitleFormattingOptions.description: Optional subtitle formatting rules. When provided, translate+subtitle segmentation runs for each target language.

max_segment_duration_in_seconds.title: Max Segment Duration In Seconds
max_segment_duration_in_seconds.description: The longest a single cue may stay on screen.

min_segment_duration_in_seconds.title: Min Segment Duration In Seconds
min_segment_duration_in_seconds.description: The shortest a single cue may stay on screen.

max_characters_in_segment.title: Max Characters In Segment
max_characters_in_segment.description: The maximum number of characters allowed in one cue.

media_url.title: Media URL
media_url.description: Public or signed URL to the media file for subtitle generation. Supports both video and audio files.

source_language.description: The language spoken in the source media. Pass a locale tag (`en-us`, `fr-fr`, `es-es`). Numeric language IDs still work but are deprecated. [See all source languages](/api-reference/endpoint/get-source-languages).

target_languages.title: Target Languages
target_languages.description: One or more target languages for the subtitles. Pass locale tags (`es-es`, `fr-fr`, `de-de`), including a single-item array when you only need one language. Numeric language IDs still work but are deprecated. [See all target languages](/api-reference/endpoint/get-target-languages).

transcription_mode.title: Transcription Mode
transcription_mode.description: Transcription mode. `fast` (default) is quicker; `slow` takes longer and may produce a more accurate transcript.

formatting_options.description: Optional subtitle formatting rules as a JSON object. When provided, subtitle segmentation runs for every target language. Omit to skip segmentation.

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: Optional folder ID to place the run in your workspace.

id.title: Id
id.description: The id of the deleted template.

name.title: Name
name.description: The template's name, unique within the workspace.

stream_id.title: Stream Id
stream_id.description: The id of a created stream in your workspace whose configuration the template saves.

APIKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
APIKeyHeader.description: The `x-api-key` is a custom header required for authenticating requests to our API. Include this header in your request with the appropriate API key value to securely access our endpoints. You can find your API key(s) in the 'API' section of our studio website.
